nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3 - 4-Step Fast Video (FastVideo VSA + Semantic Bridge)

Text to video and image to video with native audio in 4 steps. Three speed and quality pieces stacked on MiniMax H3:
- **Turbo LoRA** (lightx2v): 4 steps
- **Sparse attention gate** (FastVideo team, ComfyUI port by Kablex): skips most of the attention work, 75% sparsity
- **Semantic Bridge** (speach1sdef178): ~11 MB adapter for better prompt adherence

**How to use**
- Fast Groups Muter: leave "Image To Video" OFF for text to video, ON for image to video (load a full-size picture and match its aspect ratio in the Resolution Selector).
- Resolution Selector: 2:3 portrait, 0.6 MP for text to video; up to 1.0 MP for image to video if you have the VRAM.
- Write the prompt like a short scene: the subject, the place, the action, and the sounds you want.

**Tested settings (inside the subgraph):** sampler er_sde + scheduler sgm_uniform, 4 steps, MiniMax Sigma Shift ON (video 6, audio 3). Works for BOTH text and image to video and was the fastest combo.

**Speed tip:** use PyTorch built for CUDA 13 (cu130, the standard nvidia portable build) with an NVIDIA driver 580+. On cu128 ComfyUI turns its fast kernels off and prints a warning: same workflow went from 4:30 to 1:37 sampling.

**VRAM:** measured peak ~13 GB; with a 12 GB limit text to video still ran at full speed. A full Task Manager is normal (ComfyUI caches models in free VRAM). To keep 1 GB free for other apps add --vram-headroom 1 to the end of the line in run_nvidia_gpu.bat (2 if you record or game). 8 GB cards spill into system RAM and get slow.

On my test GPU (RTX A4500): text to video 5 s at 0.6 MP sampled in about a minute.

Spectrum node is present but disabled. Video by TheLocalLab: youtube.com/@TheLocalLab

nodes.title: Note: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**Base H3 models** - https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main
- minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors (~21 GB) -> ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/
  - optional smaller: minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_w6a8.safetensors (~16 GB, same speed, similar quality)
- qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors (~16 GB) -> ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/
- minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors + minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors -> ComfyUI/models/vae/

**Turbo LoRA** (lightx2v) - https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/tree/main
- minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors (~2 GB) -> ComfyUI/models/loras/

**FastVideo VSA gate** - https://huggingface.co/barelymining/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-FastVideo/tree/main
- fasth3_vsa_gate.safetensors (~3.9 GB) -> ComfyUI/models/loras/

**Semantic Bridge adapter** (speach1sdef178) - https://huggingface.co/speach1sdef178/MiniMax-H3-Semantic-Bridge/tree/main
- MiniMaxH3_SemanticBridge_v1.safetensors (~11 MB) -> ComfyUI/models/semantic_bridge/ (create the folder)

**Semantic Bridge custom node** is NOT in the Manager: download MiniMax_H3_Semantic_Bridge_v1.0.zip from the same repo, extract into ComfyUI/custom_nodes/. Windows "Extract All" adds an extra folder: move the inner MiniMax_H3_Semantic_Bridge folder up into custom_nodes, delete the empty one, restart ComfyUI.

Other nodes (Ref2VA VSA by Kablex, Memory Cleanup, Nvidia RTX Nodes, KJNodes, rgthree, VideoHelperSuite): install with ComfyUI Manager -> Install Missing Custom Nodes.

widgets_values: A young woman with long dark curly hair in a fitted emerald green satin dress dances in a candlelit courtyard under string lights at night. She spins, her dress and curls swirling around her, then stops, laughs and reaches her arms out. Warm acoustic guitar music and her laughter.

widgets_values_named.prompt: A young woman with long dark curly hair in a fitted emerald green satin dress dances in a candlelit courtyard under string lights at night. She spins, her dress and curls swirling around her, then stops, laughs and reaches her arms out. Warm acoustic guitar music and her laughter.

widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a young woman dancing happily in the center of a bright, softly lit studio with a white backdrop. The camera holds a mostly static shot with a slight push in at slow speed as she moves in time with the music, spinning and swaying with a wide smile. As she dances, her outfit transforms in a smooth, continuous morph: from a light floral sundress into a tailored business suit, then into soft pajamas, then into a plain red lifeguard swimsuit, then into fitted gym attire, and finally back into the original floral sundress. Each change flows seamlessly with her motion without interrupting the dance, her expression cheerful and energetic throughout.

overall_soundscape: The soft sounds of fabric shifting and footsteps tapping against the studio floor as she dances, with a light room ambience underneath.

non_diegetic_music: An upbeat, cheerful pop track at a lively tempo with a bright melody, steady danceable rhythm, and a warm major key that carries energy from start to finish.
